desc: Back by popular demand and at a very nice price! The updated version of our traditionally-styled Bobwhite, the G2 gets a CNCed receiver and modern internals that slim the action while increasing longevity and reliability. With double triggers and an English-style straight grip, quick choke decisions can be made on the fly. Finished in our hardy black chrome from head to toe, the Bobwhite G2 will resist rust much better than a blued gun while still looking classy. Its 28? barrels are threaded for choke tubes and it ships with five flush chokes spanning from Cylinder to Full.
